text.en: Believing the fictitious image charge is a real physical charge that actually exists behind the conductor — it's a mathematical device that reproduces the correct boundary condition; the only real charge is the induced surface charge on the conductor's actual, physical surface.
text.et: Arvamus, et fiktiivne peegellaeng on tõeline füüsikaline laeng, mis tegelikult eksisteerib juhi taga — see on matemaatiline abivahend, mis taastab õige rajatingimuse; ainus tõeline laeng on indutseeritud pinnalaeng juhi tegelikul, füüsikalisel pinnal.
